scope: External dependencies directly used by product runtime or optional integration paths.

packages.name: @assistant-ui/react
packages.purpose: Headless conversation runtime exposed through the shared Web UI package and vendor entry.
packages.rationale: Pins the B-0 verified React 18 compatible runtime while keeping external UI imports inside @agnes/web-ui.

packages.name: @assistant-ui/tap
packages.purpose: Reactive state dependency used by the pinned assistant-ui conversation runtime.
packages.rationale: Pins the transitive version that passed B-0 because the newer compatible-range release failed the fixture's initial state read.

packages.name: antd
packages.purpose: Accessible browser UI primitives used by the shared Web UI foundation.
packages.rationale: Keeps the A-line UI migration on one pinned component implementation while the web package consumes only the @agnes/web-ui boundary.

packages.name: @earendil-works/pi-ai
packages.purpose: Provider adapters, model catalog and streaming AI protocol support.
packages.rationale: Uses the project's selected public AI abstraction instead of maintaining parallel provider implementations.

packages.name: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
packages.purpose: MCP client transport and protocol interoperability.
packages.rationale: Provides the canonical TypeScript implementation of the external MCP contract.

packages.name: @joplin/turndown-plugin-gfm
packages.purpose: Adds GitHub Flavored Markdown table and strikethrough rules to public-page conversion.
packages.rationale: Uses the maintained Turndown GFM rules instead of duplicating Markdown conversion behavior.

packages.name: @standard-schema/spec
packages.purpose: Schema specification interface consumed by the vendored Cordis core at runtime.
packages.rationale: Vendored @agnes/cordis (from npm @deepseek-ai/cordis@4.0.2) pins this exact version; provenance recorded in packages/cordis/VENDORED.md.

packages.name: @sinclair/typebox
packages.purpose: Runtime JSON-schema construction and static TypeScript schema inference.
packages.rationale: Keeps runtime validation schemas and compile-time protocol types derived from one definition.

packages.name: es-module-lexer
packages.purpose: Parses the static and literal dynamic ESM dependency graph of browser client-module snapshots.
packages.rationale: Avoids treating comments or ordinary strings as imports while enumerating the immutable browser resource closure.

packages.name: ajv-formats
packages.purpose: Standard format validation for MCP tool input schemas and protocol parity tests.
packages.rationale: Provides RFC 3986 URI validation for external MCP schemas without maintaining a separate validator.

packages.name: dingtalk-stream
packages.purpose: Optional DingTalk streaming channel integration.
packages.rationale: Uses DingTalk's maintained stream SDK for its proprietary gateway protocol.

packages.name: get-east-asian-width
packages.purpose: Unicode terminal cell-width calculation for the CLI.
packages.rationale: Avoids incorrect cursor layout for East Asian wide and full-width characters.

packages.name: isomorphic-git
packages.purpose: Programmatic Git operations for base extensions.
packages.rationale: Provides Git behavior through a JavaScript API without assuming a shell Git executable.

packages.name: ipaddr.js
packages.purpose: Parses and classifies resolved IPv4 and IPv6 addresses for bounded public retrieval.
packages.rationale: Provides well-tested address parsing for the public-network deny rules, including IPv4-mapped IPv6 forms.

packages.name: jiti
packages.purpose: Loads TypeScript and modern JavaScript extension modules in Host and the confined Base runner.
packages.rationale: Supports the extension authoring formats accepted by the Host loader without a separate compile step.

packages.name: marked
packages.purpose: Parses assistant Markdown for terminal and Web rendering.
packages.rationale: Uses one maintained Markdown lexer; the Web client renders tokens through a DOM allowlist rather than inserting parser HTML.

packages.name: turndown
packages.purpose: Converts fetched HTML into bounded Markdown tool output.
packages.rationale: Uses a maintained HTML-to-Markdown implementation before applying the product's output limits.

packages.name: undici
packages.purpose: Provides the explicit HTTP dispatcher used by bounded public retrieval.
packages.rationale: Allows connection policy and redirect handling to stay under Host control instead of relying on ambient global fetch state.

packages.name: ws
packages.purpose: WebSocket client transport and authenticated daemon listener.
packages.rationale: Supplies the Node WebSocket implementation needed where the browser-native API is unavailable.

packages.name: yaml
packages.purpose: Parses and serializes user configuration, channel configuration and extension resources.
packages.rationale: Provides standards-aware YAML parsing with explicit document-level error handling.

packages.name: ajv
packages.purpose: Compile Extension and MCP tool schemas at runtime and independently verify protocol conformance.
packages.rationale: Reuse the established schema implementation; reject invalid or external references before callbacks run.
